subject: Next steps: migration playbook & deployment trade-offs (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Verma <amit@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + migration playbook options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Thanks for taking the time today, Amit — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what I heard (please correct me if I missed anything):
- FinBank has a customer-facing chat feature that needs PII-safe handling and strict audit trails.
- Current stack: in-house legacy GPU cluster running an older LLM (self-hosted) + ad-hoc calls to several LLM APIs for overflow.
- Primary considerations: data residency (US-only), SOC2 evidence, predictable latency during market hours, and a migration plan that avoids a hard cutover during peak batch jobs.

Options we discussed briefly:
1) Hosted API (fastest to production, minimal ops, Redwood-managed security controls). Good for quick time-to-value but requires contract/data residency scoping.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) — predictable throughput and isolation, meets many enterprise needs with SLAs.
3) Private VPC / on-prem package — fully customer-controlled network and KMS/HSM integration; recommended for regulated data or strict policy needs but longest lead time.

Immediate asks from our side to produce a tailored migration playbook:
- Can you send a short doc or diagram of the current infra (GPU cluster size, approximate QPS during peak, and which data flows must remain in-house)?
- Rough target timeline for a proof-of-concept (POC) and for a staged cutover (Q1 2027? Q2?).
- Any procurement constraints (vendor forms, required security questionnaire owners)?

I attached a simple template you can drop architecture notes into — will use it to propose one of three playbooks (Start Hosted → Gradual Dedicated; Direct Dedicated onboarding; Private VPC staged cutover).

Proposed next steps:
- You: drop the current-arch PDF and the SLA spreadsheet I attached (or send procurement contact).
- Us: Marissa to run a technical pre-check and propose a POC scope; Dev to map cost and leash (reserved capacity) options; I’ll prepare a migration playbook draft for your review.

If useful I can also schedule a 60-minute deep-dive with our security lead to review SOC2, KMS/HSM integration, and private VPC networking constraints. Are mornings PST on Friday or next Tuesday afternoon PST better for you?

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: migration_playbook_template.docx (docx)]

From: Amit Verma <amit@finbank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinBank ProdOps <prodops@finbank.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + migration playbook options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Laura — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a few clarifications: 

Clarifications:
- Our primary requirement is that customer PII and transaction traces remain within our control; we can open to Redwood-hosted for stateless inference only if we can ensure strict redaction + audit logs and a legal addendum for data handling.
- The legacy GPU cluster is NVIDIA A100-based, about 8x cards, running an in-house xen host. Peak QPS currently about 6 qps for the chat (bursts to 12 qps for short intervals). Latency SLO target: sub-300ms 95th for the chat surface.
- Procurement: we have a standard vendor onboarding packet and a security questionnaire — I’ve attached the forms. Our procurement owner is Nora Patel (nora.patel@finbank.com).

Attached: finbank_current_architecture.pdf and sla_requirements.xlsx. We can do a POC in Q1 2027; would prefer a phased approach rather than disruptive cutover.

Availability for a security deep-dive: next Tuesday afternoon PST works for us. Can Marissa join for the technical checks too?

— Amit

[Attachment: finbank_current_architecture.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: sla_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Verma <amit@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + migration playbook options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Perfect — thanks for the docs and the procurement contact. A few follow-ups after a quick read: 

1) Migration playbook suggestion (high level):
- Phase A: Quick POC (2-4 weeks) — Hosted API with strict request-side redaction + audit logging to demonstrate functionality and measure end-to-end latency. No PII persists in Redwood-managed ephemeral caches.
- Phase B: Dedicated pilot (4-8 weeks) — Reserve a small dedicated pool (N GPUs) colocated in your preferred region; integrate single-tenant KV encryption and KMS. Works for predictable latency during market hours.
- Phase C: Private VPC (optional longer-term) — If the compliance team requires full control over network and HSM, we run the Private deployment onboarding (longer lead time, includes network design and on-prem packaging).

2) Questions we need answered before we size a Dedicated pilot: 
- Expected concurrent sessions for pilot (examples: 50, 200, 1,000 concurrent users)
- Typical input token length and max response tokens you will use in the chat (affects KV/cache sizing)
- Whether you need on-the-wire encryption to a customer-managed HSM (yes/no)

3) Action items assigned:
- Amit: confirm procurement owner and preferred POC start window (you emailed Nora — thanks).
- Marissa: will prepare a short tech pre-check checklist for next Tuesday’s call (network ports, peering options, and an outline for redaction/audit demo).
- Dev: will draft an initial dedicated-capacity estimate and list of recommended GPU counts for pilot.
- Laura: I’ll draft the migration playbook and a proposed POC statement of work (SOW) to share before the call.

If this looks good I’ll get the calendar invite out for Tuesday 14:00 PST and include our security lead + Marissa + Dev.

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_poc_sow_draft.docx (docx)]

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@finbank.com>

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + migration playbook options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Laura — thanks for coordinating. I’m the procurement owner; attaching the vendor packet and our standard legal addendum request. We’ll need a short timeline for vendor onboarding (security review + legal) to share with our finance team.

A few quick notes for sizing/ops:
- We prefer dedicated pilot sizing to target 95th percentile load ~15 qps to give headroom over current peaks.
- Token budgeting: estimate 120 input tokens / 180 output tokens on average.
- Please include a sample SOC2 attestation and an outline of audit log retention policies in your POC materials.

Attaching: prodops_network_map.png and vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf. Looking forward to the Tuesday deep-dive.

Best,
Nora Patel
Procurement Lead, FinBank
